id: title:a-lider:add user password and session containment command

review.posthog_relevance: Provides an administrative command for account recovery and credential reset, allowing operators to disable passwords and revoke web sessions for specific users while preserving account history and audit trails.
review.reason: Adds a Django management command that disables passwords and revokes web sessions for selected users, recording an audit entry. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for account recovery and credential reset, though it does not change password hashes or revoke API/OAuth credentials. No broader systemic changes or unverified outcomes are demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on a single hunk; broader context or related hunks are unavailable, and the actual deployment or operational benefit is not independently verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains a single hunk P1.F1.H1. No other hunks are supplied, so no relationship between multiple hunks or broader change group can be established. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a Django management command that, given a UUID and an operator, disables passwords and revokes web sessions for selected users, while recording an audit LogEntry.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides an administrative path for account recovery or credential reset without changing the password hash, while preserving the account and its associated sessions. The command also revokes other web sessions, potentially mitigating session hijacking. It does not revoke API/OAuth credentials, which remain unchanged.
